subject.title: Feature request: config option to suppress transient tool error warnings

question: Should OpenClaw add a new final-only tool-error delivery mode, or keep `messages.suppressToolErrors` as the only normal-chat opt-out for these warning bubbles?
rationale: The code can implement either shape, but the choice changes user-visible safety semantics for failed mutating actions and adds or redefines configuration surface.

options.title: Add final-only policy
options.body: Define `all | final | off` semantics, preserve current default safety behavior, and test success/acknowledgement detection before adding the new config surface.

options.title: Keep off-only policy
options.body: Document `messages.suppressToolErrors` as the supported operator opt-out and decline final-only suppression until stronger failure classification exists.

options.title: Route warnings elsewhere
options.body: Defer suppression and handle operator noise through a dedicated warning destination/category design such as the related routing issue.

recommendation.title: Add final-only policy
recommendation.body: Define `all | final | off` semantics, preserve current default safety behavior, and test success/acknowledgement detection before adding the new config surface.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work in the same warning path explicitly separated narrow Telegram fixes from this broader policy item.
